stem_book: Find the frictional force if the block is at rest on the given curved surface: a block M = 10 kg rests on the inside of a parabolic surface x² = 2y (y vertical) at the point (1, 1/2); coefficient of friction μ = 5/4. (g = 10 m/s²)
work: tanθ = dy/dx = x = 1 → θ = 45° (tanθ < μ, so static); f = mg sinθ = 100/√2 ≈ 70.7 N
